description: Carryover KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP fix + shared foundations every Phase 2 service needs. Independent of other FEATs and MUST land first: fix the Phase 1 review bug (KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP kafka:9092 -> redpanda:9092 so services actually reach the Redpanda broker advertised at redpanda:9092 in deploy/docker-compose.yml), add a shared Kafka topic map to acip-common (topic names differ from event-type strings per docs/03 §2 and acip-common has none today), add the Phase 2 config keys to Settings + .env.example, and register services/* as uv workspace members so later FEATs can add service packages.
steps: Fix the carryover bug: in libs/acip-common/src/acip_common/config.py change the kafka_bootstrap Field default from 'kafka:9092' to 'redpanda:9092'; in .env.example change KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP=kafka:9092 to KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP=redpanda:9092. Verify deploy/docker-compose.yml advertises PLAINTEXT://redpanda:9092 (it does) so the names match. Run `grep -rn 'kafka:9092' . --include=*.py --include=*.example --include=*.yml --include=*.toml` and confirm no stale alias remains outside docs/ (docs are frozen and may still reference kafka:9092 in prose; do not edit docs).

Create libs/acip-common/src/acip_common/topics.py: module-level constants TXN_LIFECYCLE='txn.lifecycle', TXN_EVALUATE='txn.evaluate', AGENT_VERDICTS='agent.verdicts', DECISION_LOG='decision.log' and the DLQ names (e.g. TXN_LIFECYCLE_DLQ='txn.lifecycle.dlq' etc., matching deploy/docker-compose.yml kafka-init). Add topic_for(event_type: EventType) -> str mapping each acip_common.schemas.EventType to its topic per docs/03 §2 (txn.created/txn.executed/txn.declined/txn.challenged -> txn.lifecycle; txn.evaluate.requested -> txn.evaluate; agent.verdict.produced -> agent.verdicts; decision.rendered -> decision.log). Include a module docstring citing docs/03 §2. Export all public names in __all__.

Add libs/acip-common/tests/test_topics.py asserting topic_for() returns the correct topic for every EventType member and that the constants equal the kafka-init topic names in deploy/docker-compose.yml.

Add Phase 2 config keys to libs/acip-common/src/acip_common/config.py Settings (all with defaults so the stack boots with no .env) and mirror them in .env.example: REPRESENTATION_URL (default http://representation-service:8000), ML_SCORING_URL (http://ml-scoring-service:8000), LLM_GATEWAY_URL (http://llm-gateway:8000), DECISION_ENGINE_URL (http://decision-engine:8000), PAYMENT_PROCESSOR_URL (http://payment-processor-sim:8000), ORCHESTRATOR_URL (http://commerce-orchestrator:8000), ML_MODELS_DIR (default /app/ml/models), SIM_FAILURE_MODE (default 'none'), MISSING_RISK_FRAUD_POLICY (default 'CHALLENGE'). Keep existing keys unchanged.

In root pyproject.toml add 'services/*' to [tool.uv.workspace] members (now ['libs/*', 'services/*']). Do not change [tool.uv.sources] or tool configs. Note: with no service packages present yet, keep this change valid by ensuring at least the glob resolves to zero members cleanly, or land this step together with FEAT-002's first service pyproject if uv rejects an empty glob (verify with uv sync).
Run uv sync and the acip-common gate to confirm the lib still builds and resolves.
acceptance_criteria: libs/acip-common/src/acip_common/config.py and .env.example both set the Kafka bootstrap to redpanda:9092; `grep -rn 'kafka:9092'` finds matches only inside docs/.
acip_common.topics exposes the four topic constants + DLQ names + topic_for(), and topic_for covers every EventType member.
Settings exposes the new Phase 2 keys with the documented defaults and still loads with no .env present.
Root pyproject.toml lists services/* as a workspace member and `uv sync` succeeds.
verification: uv run pytest libs/acip-common  (all tests incl. new test_topics.py pass)
findings:
LANDED (all verification green: pytest 22 passed, ruff clean, mypy strict clean, black clean, compose config OK, grep 'kafka:9092' finds nothing in *.py/*.toml/*.example/*.yml).

KAFKA FIX: config.py Settings.kafka_bootstrap default now 'redpanda:9092'; .env.example KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP=redpanda:9092. Matches compose advertise-kafka-addr PLAINTEXT://redpanda:9092. test_config.py default assertion updated to redpanda:9092.

TOPICS (acip_common.topics): constants TXN_LIFECYCLE='txn.lifecycle', TXN_EVALUATE='txn.evaluate', AGENT_VERDICTS='agent.verdicts', DECISION_LOG='decision.log'; DLQs TXN_LIFECYCLE_DLQ='txn.lifecycle.dlq', TXN_EVALUATE_DLQ='txn.evaluate.dlq', AGENT_VERDICTS_DLQ='agent.verdicts.dlq', DECISION_LOG_DLQ='decision.log.dlq'. topic_for(EventType)->str mapping: TXN_CREATED/TXN_EXECUTED/TXN_DECLINED/TXN_CHALLENGED -> txn.lifecycle; TXN_EVALUATE_REQUESTED -> txn.evaluate; AGENT_VERDICT_PRODUCED -> agent.verdicts; DECISION_RENDERED -> decision.log. Import these, never redefine. topic_for raises KeyError on unknown members (all 7 EventType members covered).

NEW CONFIG KEYS on Settings (snake_case attr / ENV_ALIAS = default): representation_url / REPRESENTATION_URL = http://representation-service:8000; ml_scoring_url / ML_SCORING_URL = http://ml-scoring-service:8000; llm_gateway_url / LLM_GATEWAY_URL = http://llm-gateway:8000; decision_engine_url / DECISION_ENGINE_URL = http://decision-engine:8000; payment_processor_url / PAYMENT_PROCESSOR_URL = http://payment-processor-sim:8000; orchestrator_url / ORCHESTRATOR_URL = http://commerce-orchestrator:8000; ml_models_dir / ML_MODELS_DIR = /app/ml/models; sim_failure_mode / SIM_FAILURE_MODE = none; missing_risk_fraud_policy / MISSING_RISK_FRAUD_POLICY = CHALLENGE. All mirrored in .env.example. Existing keys unchanged; stack still loads with no .env.

WORKSPACE: root pyproject.toml [tool.uv.workspace] members = ['libs/*', 'services/*']. uv rejects members matching dirs that lack a pyproject.toml, so an exclude list was added covering all 14 currently-empty services/* dirs (.gitkeep only). ACTION FOR LATER FEATS: when you add a service's pyproject.toml, REMOVE that service's path from [tool.uv.workspace].exclude in root pyproject.toml so it becomes a real workspace member, then run uv sync. Phase-3 agent dirs (risk/fraud/routing/policy/merchant/checkout-personalization agents, graph-projector) stay in exclude until Phase 3. [tool.uv.sources] and tool configs were not touched.
